multiplechoiceresponse.p: A user reports the computer is "slow". Memory, CPU and disk all read low, but the network usage is pinned near the limit. The bottleneck is most likely:

div.p: Performance is constrained by CPU, memory, disk, or network. Read the resource that is saturated, not the symptom the user names.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: A user can open a shared folder but cannot save into it, and sees "permission denied". The most likely cause is:

choice.div: The account lacks write permission on the folder.
The monitor needs to be replaced.

div.p: "Permission denied" on one action points at access rights, not hardware. Check effective permissions on the folder and the group above it.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: An operating system reaches "end of support". The correct response is to:

choice.div: Keep using it — support ended only affects new features.
Plan to upgrade or replace it, because it no longer receives security patches.
Disable the firewall to improve performance.

div.p: Without security updates, known vulnerabilities stay exploitable forever. An unsupported OS cannot be made secure and must be upgraded or replaced.
